title: Kuwait Mein Drone Hamla: Do Italian Technicians Ki Maut, Iran Ne Aarop Se Inkaar Kiya
summary: Kuwait me ek vital facility par hue drone hamle me German company ke do Italian technicians ki maut ho gayi hai. Italy aur Kuwait ne iske liye Iran ko zimmedar bataya hai, jabki Iran ne isme kisi bhi tarah ke haath hone se inkaar kiya hai.
key_points: Kuwait me ek air defense site par drone hamle ke dauran do Italian technicians ki jaan chali gayi.
Ye dono technicians German defense company Rheinmetall ke liye maintenance ka kaam kar rahe the.
Kuwait aur Italy ne iske liye Iran par aarop lagaya hai, jabki Tehran ne isse saaf inkar kiya hai.
Iran ke foreign minister ne Kuwait ke sath milkar is incident ki joint investigation karne ki baat kahi hai.
body: Kuwait me ek vital site par hue drone explosion me do Italian nationals ki maut ho gayi hai. Ye dono log German arms manufacturing company Rheinmetall ki Italian unit ke liye technicians ke taur par kaam kar rahe the. Reports ke mutabiq, ye hadsa ek air defense detection station par hua jahan ye systems ki maintenance kar rahe the.

Italy aur Kuwait ki governments ne is attack ke liye seedhe taur par Iran ko zimmedar thehraya hai. Kuwaiti defense ministry ka kehna hai ki ye ek 'heinous Iranian aggression' ka natija hai jisme falling shrapnel ki wajah se do Italians ki maut hui aur kuch anya log zakhmi bhi hue. Italian Foreign Minister ne bataya ki is mamle me Iran ke embassy me shiqayat darj ki jayegi.

Wahin dusri taraf, Iran ne in sabhi aaronpo ko kharij kar diya hai. Iran ke armed forces spokesperson ne kaha hai ki unki military ki taraf se koi bhi offensive operation nahi kiya gaya hai. Iske alawa, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi ne bhi isme Tehran ke shamil hone se inkar kiya hai aur Kuwait ke sath milkar is ghatna ki joint investigation karne ki peshkash ki hai.

Ye tanaav aise waqt me badha hai jab pichle kuch mahino se US aur Israel ke sath chal rahe conflict ke chaleye Gulf countries me bhi security ke halaat kharab hain. European leaders ne bhi is hamle ki ninda ki hai aur Gulf region me badhte tanaav par chinta jatayi hai.
why_it_matters: Gulf region me badhta tanaav aur is tarah ke hamle international security aur wahan rehne wale employees ke liye bada khatra ban rahe hain. Isse regional stability par bhi bada asar pad raha hai.
